Traffic_Counter.label: Traffic Counter
Traffic_Counter.description: The uCIFI traffic counter provides vehicle counting and traffic analysis data. A traffic counting device may implement multiple instances of this traffic counter object, each of them being in charge of counting different categories of vehicles (e.g. bikes, cars, trucks).

Cumulated_number.label: Cumulated number
Cumulated_number.description: Cumulated number of vehicles counted since last reset.

Cumulated_number_today.label: Cumulated number today
Cumulated_number_today.description: Cumulated number of vehicles counted today.

Measuring_period_1.label: Measuring period 1
Measuring_period_1.description: Time period 1 during which the counter shall provide number of vehicles (e.g. 1 hour).

Measuring_period_2.label: Measuring period 2
Measuring_period_2.description: Time period 2 during which the counter shall provide number of vehicles (e.g. 15 minutes).

Measuring_period_3.label: Measuring period 3
Measuring_period_3.description: Time period 3 during which the counter shall provide number of vehicles (e.g. 5 minutes).

Cumulated_number_during_last_period_1.label: Cumulated number during last period 1
Cumulated_number_during_last_period_1.description: Cumulated number of vehicles counted during the last period 1 (e.g. 1 hour).

Cumulated_number_during_last_period_2.label: Cumulated number during last period 2
Cumulated_number_during_last_period_2.description: Cumulated number of vehicles counted during the last period 2 (e.g. 15 minutes).

Cumulated_number_during_last_period_3.label: Cumulated number during last period 3
Cumulated_number_during_last_period_3.description: Cumulated number of vehicles counted during the last period 3 (e.g. 5 minutes).

Average_speed_during_last_period_1.label: Average speed during last period 1
Average_speed_during_last_period_1.description: Average speed measured on the vehicles during the last period 1 (e.g. 1 hour).

Average_speed_during_last_period_2.label: Average speed during last period 2
Average_speed_during_last_period_2.description: Average speed measured on the vehicles during the last period 2 (e.g. 15 minutes).

Average_speed_during_last_period_3.label: Average speed during last period 3
Average_speed_during_last_period_3.description: Average speed measured on the vehicles during the last period 3 (e.g. 5 minutes).

Average_distance_during_last_period_1.label: Average distance during last period 1
Average_distance_during_last_period_1.description: Average distance between two vehicles measured during the last period 1 (e.g. 1 hour).

Average_distance_during_last_period_2.label: Average distance during last period 2
Average_distance_during_last_period_2.description: Average distance between two vehicles measured during the last period 2 (e.g. 15 minutes).

Average_distance_during_last_period_3.label: Average distance during last period 3
Average_distance_during_last_period_3.description: Average distance between two vehicles measured during the last period 3 (e.g. 5 minutes).

Speed_limit_threshold.label: Speed limit threshold
Speed_limit_threshold.description: Speed limit threshold used to calculate the percentage of vehicles above speed limit.

Percentage_above_speed_limit.label: Percentage above speed limit
Percentage_above_speed_limit.description: Percentage of vehicles driving above speed limit.

Reset_cumulated_number.label: Reset cumulated number
Reset_cumulated_number.description: Reset the cumulated number of vehicles.
